  id,
  name,
  element,
  type,
  focus,
  limit,
  effects,
  text,
  extra = {},
) {
  cards[id] = {
    id,
    name,
    element,
    type,
    focus,
    limit,
    channel: 1,
    recall: type === "Ally" ? null : 1,
    effects,
    text,
    rarity: "common",
    ...(type === "Ward" ? { ward: 1 } : {}),
    ...extra,

      rarity: "rare",
      offerWeight: 1,
      limit: 1,
      recall: null,
      singleUse: true,
      destroyAfterActivation: true,
      text:
